item.statement: The contract is exact and tolerance-free; identical inputs must yield bitwise identical outputs across repetitions, and there is no acceptable f32 deviation.

plans.objective: Verify exactness and repeat stability, explicitly excluding any host tolerance such as the sample 0.15f comparison.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate artifact, run the repeated launches on Ascend 950PR, and capture every odata buffer.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff all three outputs are bitwise identical to each other and to the host oracle; any nonzero deviation fails.
plans.setup: Run the candidate three times with the same input and shifts; compute host oracle; compare all outputs bitwise.
